finding: The process exited 143 but a reparented sleep 60 held the stdout pipe, so communicate waited. descendants used pgrep, which this host does not have, so cleanup never saw the abandoned sleep. HUP interrupts wait; the old code cleared SLEEP_PID and started a second sleep. descendants now reads /proc. The cycle sleep re-waits while its sleep is alive. communicate then returns in about a second. Both are one trial. Heat is zero.
mitigation: Read children from /proc. Re-wait the cycle sleep while it is alive so HUP cannot abandon it.
